auth_details: API key via Authorization Bearer header or query parameter (self-serve signup on Covalent platform)
free_tier_limits: Premium free tier includes limited credits; exact credit caps vary by plan and are set at signup (see GoldRush platform pricing).
rate_limits: Credit-based usage; specific RPS/rate limits not always published publicly—managed via platform credits and plan.
description: Covalent (now also branded GoldRush) provides a unified REST API that indexes blockchain data across many networks so developers can query balances, transactions, token transfers, NFTs, and historical prices without running their own nodes. Typical usage is authenticated API-key requests against a versioned HTTPS base URL for wallet portfolio, activity, and token metadata endpoints.
resolution_notes: Disputes on pricing and rate_limits under live verification.
